- Cast to your TV! — Tap the cast button at the top of the player and pick your TV: it plays the video from YouTube in full quality, right from where you were, and your phone becomes the remote, with play, pause and Stop casting. TVs on your Wi-Fi show up by themselves, including Google TV, Android TV and Chromecast; for any other, choose Link with TV code and type the code the TV shows in its settings.
- Shorts in search — Search results now show Shorts as tall tiles side by side, like the YouTube app, and they open in the Shorts player instead of the regular one, so a portrait video no longer turns sideways in full screen. Swipe up to go through the other Shorts from your search.
